about: Round 75b (docs/SEED_GUARANTEES_PLAN.md section 2, written as 'round 79' there): per story, the roles that must be in the army by the first chapter that needs them. IDs and chapter ids only, no game values. 'army' = who is in the army at that chapter (round 72's break check read it from memory on saves made by playing the story; a male Corrin; the chapter-7 lists are the saves after chapter 7, so one chapter generous). An entry that is a list is one slot: it covers a need only if every person in it does (the retainer slot: which retainer stays depends on Corrin's sex, call 5). Checked by: python tools/randomizer/guarantees.py facts.

roles.door: the lock-opening skill in the person's own skills or the class's skills (keys are not counted)
roles.staff: a class with a staff rank; a repaired healer's join placement carries a staff (call 3)
roles.flier: a class in the flying category (rules.json recruit.flier_job_category)
roles.vein: the dragon-vein person flag (Corrin and the royals; never edited)

never_repaired_note: kept people (lord, singer, royals with a legendary weapon), rules.json recruit.recruit_fixed / recruit_hold / recruit_castle and the four royals are never given a class by a repair (guarantees.py held()), with one exception: the last resort (guarantees.py last_resort()) may re-class rules.json recruit_fixed (Gunter) when nobody else in that chapter's army can take the role (round 75b; shuffle 'any' only in the sweeps).
